amountRupees.description: Amount in rupees as a plain number; null if not stated

category.description: Exactly one of the user's category names, or null

merchant.description: Shop/brand/app name, properly spelled; null if none

note.description: Short description of what was bought; null if nothing beyond the merchant

date.description: yyyy-MM-dd when the spend happened; null means today

queryCategory.description: Category name a CATEGORY_LEFT question is about

confidence.description: 0..1, how sure you are of this reading
